summary: Completed comprehensive testing of three new features: Narration Status Panel, Demo Cleanup, and Admin Warm Trigger. All backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin login successful with token generation
Backend: GET /api/admin/narrations without auth returns 401/403
Backend: GET /api/admin/narrations with auth returns 200 with correct structure
Backend: Narrations endpoint returns enabled=true, warming=false, credits=null (expected), cached_count=3, total=4
Backend: Essays array contains 4 items with all required fields (slug, title, tier, cached, scopes, bytes, listens)
Backend: Five Things Commodity Desks essay correctly marked as Missing (not cached)
Backend: POST /api/admin/narrations/warm returns 200 with ok=true, started=true
Backend: Warmup process starts and encounters expected quota error (0 ElevenLabs credits)
Backend: Demo cleanup verified - GET /api/posts returns exactly 4 published posts
Backend: No demo essay titles in published posts
Backend: GET /api/admin/posts shows 4 published, 12 drafts (demo essays in drafts as expected)
Backend: Regression - /api/posts, /api/categories, /api/briefings all return 200
Backend: Regression - /api/admin/analytics/stats returns 200 with listens and listens_7d fields
Frontend: Admin login successful and redirected to admin page
Frontend: Overview tab displays Listens stat card (value: 4)
Frontend: Overview tab displays Top posts chart with views & listens
Frontend: Narrations tab exists and is clickable (data-testid='admin-tab-narrations')
Frontend: Credits remaining stat card shows '—' (null as expected)
Frontend: Credits used stat card shows '—' (null as expected)
Frontend: Essays narrated stat card shows '3 / 4'
Frontend: Total listens stat card shows '4'
Frontend: Hint text visible: 'Credit balance unavailable — enable the User → Read permission on your ElevenLabs API key'
Frontend: Narrations table (data-testid='admin-narrations-table') displays 4 rows
Frontend: Table shows 3 'Cached' badges and 1 'Missing' badge
Frontend: Five Things Commodity Desks essay has 'Missing' badge
Frontend: Generate missing narrations button (data-testid='admin-narrations-warm-button') is enabled
Frontend: Clicking Generate button shows success toast: 'Warmup started — missing narrations are being generated in the background.'
Frontend: Homepage shows only 4 real published essays (no demo titles)
Frontend: Regression - Overview tab still functional with all stat cards and charts
